title: PROPOSED MONUMENT: CHATEAU ALTO NIDO
text:
PROPOSED MONUMENT: CHATEAU ALTO NIDO

  CHC-2026-4299-HCM
  CEQA: ENV-2026-4300-CE  Council District: 13 – Soto-Martinez
  Plan Area: Hollywood  Last Day to Act: 12-01-26

  PROPERTY ADDRESS: 1851 North Ivar Avenue

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Determine that the proposed designation is categorically exempt from the California Environmental
  Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article 19, Section 15308, Class 8 and Article 19, Section 15331,
  Class 31 of the State CEQA Guidelines;
  2. Determine whether the property conforms with the definition of a Monument pursuant to Los Angeles
  Administrative Code Section 22.171.7; and
  3. Recommend that the City Council consider and declare the subject property a Historic-Cultural
  Monument.

  Owners:  Chateau Alto Nido Partners De LLC;
  Irene M. Hensel, Trustee, Irene M. Hensel Revocable Trust

  Applicants:  Brian Curran and Margot Gerber, Hollywood Heritage

  Preparers:  James Dastoli and Margot Gerber, Hollywood Heritage
summary: The Cultural Heritage Commission will decide whether Chateau Alto Nido at 1851 North Ivar Avenue meets the definition of a monument, and if so recommend that City Council declare it a Historic-Cultural Monument.
